zh: 家庭财务记账助手全面升级：支持 @家庭财务记账助手 中文技能直接调用，多轮对话自动保持记账会话状态。
新增原生家庭财务记账工具集（finance_*），支持账单小票与餐饮消费直接录入、查余额、查明细与转账，杜绝数据库工具冲突。
修复移动端与 Web 端多轮会话中技能上下文丢失问题，智能识别餐饮小票与记账确认，无需重复触发技能。
en: Family Finance Bookkeeper upgrade: supports direct Chinese @ mention and seamlessly preserves bookkeeping skill context across multi-turn chats.
Add native first-class finance tools (finance_*) for expense recording, balance checks, transactions and transfers without database tool conflicts.
Fix skill context loss across conversation turns in mobile and web apps, automatically routing dining receipts and confirmations to bookkeeping.
